Nora H.: Heads-up - vendor pentest confirmed 2026-11-08 -> 2026-11-10 against staging. Need an RBAC freeze window, KMS presign flow, log capture plan, redaction sign-off, and a single remediation+retest tracker. Who volunteers?

Ben I.: I can handle KMS + evidence bucket. Plan: create `pt-evidence-prod-like` bucket, KMS key with tight policy, issue presigned PUTs via short-lived assessor role. Default TTL 7200s. Example: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence-prod-like/staging-20261108.tgz --expires-in 7200`. Also require encryption-context `purpose=pt-evidence`.

Carlos S.: I'll take logs. Capture window: 20m before start -> 60m after end. Will include CloudTrail, app logs, nginx and worker logs. Will run `log-scrub --preview SECRET,API_KEY,TOKEN` and post results.

Deepa P.: RBAC: ephemeral role `pt_assessor_<vendor>` per account, session tags `pt:vendor=<vendor>`, MFA required. Deny direct SSH; recorded bastion only. Remove bindings 24h after test.

Raj P.: I'll run the remediation tracker and coordinate retest windows. Propose retest options wk of 2026-11-15 or 2026-11-22. I'll create a GH project board and a recurring 30m stand.

legal-bot: Reminder: redact PII and internal tokens. Legal requires sign-off before logs are shared externally.

Nora H.: Runbook sketch: 1) Spin ephemeral role and limit perms. 2) Create presigned PUTs for evidence uploads with metadata header `x-amz-meta-purpose: pt-evidence`. 3) Capture logs and run automated scrub. 4) Manual redaction if scrub flags hits; log reviewer. 5) Revoke role and rotate any temp creds. 6) If active exploit detected, pause test and escalate to oncall immediately.

Ben I.: KMS policy snippet to allow decrypt only with purpose context: `{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/pt-evidence","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:purpose":"pt-evidence"}}}`

Carlos S.: Found some debug env vars in one service during dry-run; will redact and re-run scrub. Posting scrub summary to evidence folder.

Deepa P.: If vendor requests SSH for debugging, deny. Offer recorded session playback instead.

Nora H.: Thanks. Assignments: Ben -> KMS/presign doc; Carlos -> logs + scrub; Deepa -> RBAC runbook + teardown; Raj -> remediation tracker + retest calendar; Nora -> final ops checklist and publish. Everyone add availability to the invite. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
